prompts.title: A Miniature with Chocolate
prompts.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic macro portrait of the uploaded handsome person transformed into a tiny, cute chibi-style miniature. Maintain the recognizable facial identity and glasses if present. Give the miniature an oversized semi-realistic head, a very small body, chibi body proportions, and extremely short hands and legs, while keeping the face cute and adorable.
Show the miniature standing on an off-white round tabletop and tightly hugging an extra-oversized red KitKat bar that is significantly taller and wider than his entire body. Both tiny arms should wrap firmly around the chocolate bar as if he refuses to let it go. The KitKat must look like a real wrapped chocolate bar with natural crumpled folds, a torn-open top, and partially eaten chocolate fingers clearly showing crisp wafer layers.
Add realistic chocolate smudges around his mouth, across his fingertips, and on both hands, suggesting he was just eating it. A huge realistic human hand enters from the upper-right corner, gently pinching the back collar of his jacket without covering his face or the KitKat.
Dress him in a dark navy hoodie, white T-shirt, dark slim-fit jeans, and clean matching sneakers. Give him a playful, lovable smile while looking directly at the camera.
Use a tight vertical 4:5 macro composition where the oversized head, miniature, and enormous KitKat dominate the frame. Add a few chocolate crumbs and small melted chocolate drops on the tabletop. Use a soft light-grey bokeh background, soft bright studio lighting, shallow depth of field, outfit texture, and chocolate textures, natural wrapper reflections, and a whimsical premium advertising-photography aesthetic. Avoid adult body proportions, simple background and realistic head.

prompts.title: 3D Couple Miniature
prompts.prompt:
Create a cute premium 3D animated collectible figurine scene of the uploaded couple, using their photo only as the identity reference. Turn them into an adorable husband and wife standing close together on a small round display base. Preserve their recognizable age, facial features, hairstyle, glasses if present, skin tone, and warm loving expressions, but render them in a soft Pixar-style / clay-toy figurine look.

The man stands on the left with a gentle smile, one arm lovingly around the woman’s shoulder, while the woman stands on the right, smiling warmly up at him. Their pose should feel affectionate, calm, and lifelong-romantic.
Dress both subjects in outfits inspired by their own cultural background, keeping the clothing elegant, traditional or semi-traditional, age-appropriate, modest, and visually harmonious. The outfits should feel authentic to the couple’s culture rather than generic Western clothing. For example, use culturally relevant garments, layering, patterns, jewelry, and overall styling that suit the couple naturally, while still keeping the look soft, premium, and simplified for a collectible figurine design. Avoid exaggerated costumes; keep the styling tasteful, warm, and realistic to their background.

Place a vintage black street lamp beside them with a warm glowing lantern. Attach wooden arrow signboards to the lamp post with clean readable engraved text: “MARRIED SINCE”, “HUSBAND NAME”, and “WIFE NAME”. On the front of the round base, add elegant golden text: “ENDLESS ♥ LOVE”.

Set the figurine on a wooden tabletop inside a cozy softly blurred living room, with warm golden lighting, shallow depth of field, premium miniature-diorama feel, soft shadows, smooth toy-like textures, detailed fabric, and realistic lamp glow. Keep the composition centered, heartwarming, clean, and gift-like. Square aspect ratio 1:1.

prompts.title: Mini Avatar Collection
prompts.prompt:
Create a square 1:1 collage featuring six premium 3D chibi-style renders of the same subject, arranged in a clean 3-column × 2-row grid. The subject should be reusable for any person, so use the uploaded/reference person as the base subject and transform them into a cute stylized 3D chibi character while keeping the same subject identity consistent across all six panels.

The character should have a charming animated look with an oversized head, large glossy eyes, soft rounded facial features, rosy cheeks, a small nose, a warm smile, and thick fluffy hair adapted from the subject. Keep the same subject consistent in all six panels, while changing only the outfit, pose, and expression according to each scene below.

Use soft studio lighting, rich vivid smooth gradient backgrounds with clean saturated color depth, where the outer area stays more solid and colorful while the area near the subject becomes lighter and softer, subtle floor shadows, crisp fabric textures, detailed hair strands, and a clean high-resolution polished finish. Add a soft subtle rim light along the outer edges of the subject, especially around the hair, shoulders, arms, and clothing silhouette, so the character stays clearly separated from the background without looking overlit.

prompts.title: Floating World Dioramas
prompts.prompt:
Create a 1:1 or 4:5 aspect-ratio, ultra-HD, hyper-realistic cinematic aerial poster of a floating miniature island shaped exactly like the real geographic outline of [COUNTRY NAME], suspended naturally above a vast sea of soft, volumetric clouds.
The island must look like a physical miniature diorama with realistic terrain thickness, layered geological cross-sections, cliffs, rock strata, soil layers, grass, and natural elevation depth visible along the island edges.
Automatically generate and place the most iconic landmarks, architecture, terrain features, and cultural elements of [COUNTRY NAME] in their geographically correct regions. Terrain must accurately reflect real biome distribution including mountains, rivers, coastlines, beaches, forests, deserts, or lakes depending on the country.
If the country has ocean borders or coastline, include ultra-realistic water with:
• crystal-clear turquoise shallow water near shores

• deep blue ocean gradients in deeper areas

• visible underwater terrain and shoreline fade

• realistic reflections, refraction, and light absorption

• gentle waves, foam, and coastal interaction

• subsurface scattering and transparency
Embed massive bold white 3D letters spelling "[COUNTRY NAME]" into the terrain, physically integrated with ground elevation, casting soft natural shadows.
Add realistic environmental storytelling elements:
• native animals and birds

• trees and biome-accurate vegetation

• roads, bridges, cities, or villages

• waterfalls, rivers, mist, and environmental depth
Lighting must be cinematic golden hour with:
• strong warm sunlight from horizon

• visible volumetric god rays passing through clouds

• atmospheric haze and aerial perspective

• soft light scattering

• realistic cloud shadows on terrain

• glowing sunlight reflections on water
Atmosphere must include volumetric clouds, depth fog, subtle mist, and realistic atmospheric perspective to enhance scale and realism.
Camera view: high-altitude aerial 3/4 perspective, slightly angled, centered composition, entire island fully visible.
Color grading: rich cinematic colors, vibrant but natural tones, high dynamic range, travel-poster quality.
Rendering quality: ultra-photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5, Octane render, physically based rendering (PBR), global illumination, ambient occlusion, subsurface scattering, ultra-detailed textures, sharp focus, 8K resolution.
Style: hyper-real miniature world, cinematic travel poster, ultra clean, premium, professional.
